request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, soft drums, hopeful and steady, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A new and living way he opened up
Through the curtain of his flesh we step
A great priest stands over God's house now
We draw near with true hearts and faith

[Chorus]
Hold unwaveringly to the confession
Hold unwaveringly to our hope
He who promised is faithful to us
Hold unwaveringly to the confession

[Verse]
Our hearts are sprinkled clean from evil
Bodies washed with pure and holy water
We spur one another on to love
And to good works in this life

[Chorus]
Hold unwaveringly to the confession
Hold unwaveringly to our hope
He who promised is faithful to us
Hold unwaveringly to the confession

[Bridge]
Do not neglect to meet together
Encourage one another in truth
See the Day is drawing near now
Keep our eyes fixed on the light

[Outro]
He who promised is faithful
Hold unwaveringly to the confession
